title: Into the Valley of Nimrod
summary: Jared, his brother, their families, and their friends go down into the valley of Nimrod with gathered flocks.
characters: Jared and his brother's families and friends

explicit_facts.text: Jared, his brother, their families, and their friends went down into the valley of Nimrod with flocks of every kind.

reasonable_visual_inferences: People and flocks are traveling down into a valley.
unspecified_visual_details: The travelers' appearances, clothing, number, and arrangement; the valley's terrain and vegetation; the flocks' species and colors.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the mighty hunter as present; he is only mentioned in the valley's name explanation.

title: Gathering Provisions
summary: The group catches birds, carries fish in a vessel, and brings swarms of bees and seeds of every kind.
characters: Jared and his brother's families and friends

explicit_facts.text: They laid snares and caught birds, prepared a vessel to carry fish, and carried swarms of bees and seeds of every kind.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The provisions and gathered materials are being prepared for travel.
unspecified_visual_details: Who performs each task; the vessel's design; the quantity and appearance of fish, birds, bees, and seeds.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add specific species, named individuals, or unmentioned equipment.

title: The Lord Speaks in the Cloud
summary: In the valley of Nimrod, the Lord comes down and talks with the brother of Jared from within a cloud; the brother of Jared does not see him.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord came down and talked with the brother of Jared while in a cloud, and the brother of Jared did not see him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A cloud is present as the Lord speaks; the Lord himself is not visible.
unspecified_visual_details: The cloud's shape, size, color, and position; the brother of Jared's appearance and posture.

narration.text: the Lord came down and talked

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The text explicitly says the Lord was in a cloud and was not seen; do not depict a visible divine figure.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show the Lord's appearance or invent the words spoken.

title: Directions into the Wilderness
summary: The Lord commands the travelers to go into a quarter where no person had been and leads them from within a cloud, giving directions.
characters: Jared and his brother's families and friends

explicit_facts.text: The Lord commanded them to go into a quarter where no person had been, went before them in a cloud, and gave directions for their travel.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The travelers move into the wilderness following the direction of a cloud.
unspecified_visual_details: The wilderness terrain, route, cloud's appearance, and travelers' arrangement.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Lord's presence is described as a cloud; no visible bodily appearance is stated.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the previously uninhabited quarter as a known named place.

title: Travel and Build Barges
summary: The group travels in the wilderness and builds barges to cross many waters, continually directed by the Lord.
characters: Jared and his brother's families and friends

explicit_facts.text: They traveled in the wilderness, built barges, and crossed many waters under the Lord's continual direction.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The travelers, a barge, and water may be shown as part of the described journey.
unspecified_visual_details: The barges' design, construction methods, specific waters, and visual form of the Lord's direction.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: This verse summarizes travel and multiple crossings; it does not specify a single named crossing.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a visible hand or figure for the Lord's direction.

title: The Promised Land Decree
summary: The Lord's decree is that the travelers should continue toward the land of promise, and that those possessing it must serve the true and only God or be swept off when his wrath is full.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord would not allow them to stop beyond the sea in the wilderness, but would have them reach the land of promise, preserved for a righteous people.
The Lord swore that whoever possessed the land must serve him, the true and only God, or be swept off when his wrath was full.

unspecified_visual_details: The visual setting for this narrated decree; no specific present-time location or people are described.

narration.text: serve him, the true and only God

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These verses report a decree and do not narrate a new visible event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict future destruction or an unmentioned divine appearance.

title: The Land and Its Inhabitants
summary: The record explains that any nation possessing the choice land must serve God or be swept off, and that this occurs only when iniquity is full.

explicit_facts.text: Any nation possessing the land must serve God or be swept off when iniquity is full.

unspecified_visual_details: A visual setting or people to represent the teaching; no present event is specified.

narration.text: whatsoever nation shall possess it shall serve God

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verses state a decree, not a depicted destruction.
prohibited_inventions: Do not literalize 'swept off' as a newly occurring visible event.

title: Warning to the Gentiles
summary: The record addresses the Gentiles, saying the decrees are given so they may repent and avoid continuing in iniquity until its fulness.

explicit_facts.text: The record addresses the Gentiles and says the decree is given so they may repent and not continue in iniquity until its fulness.

unspecified_visual_details: The visual setting and identities of the addressed Gentiles.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: This is a direct address in the record, not a narrated gathering or event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict named or identifiable Gentiles not supplied by the text.

title: Freedom in the Choice Land
summary: The record teaches that a nation possessing the choice land may be free from bondage, captivity, and other nations if it serves the God of the land, Jesus Christ.

explicit_facts.text: A nation possessing the choice land may be free from bondage, captivity, and other nations if it serves the God of the land, identified as Jesus Christ.

unspecified_visual_details: A visual setting, nation, or people to represent the teaching.

narration.text: the God of the land, who is Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse identifies Jesus Christ but does not describe his appearance or narrate his presence in the scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Jesus Christ as physically present; this verse gives no appearance or present encounter.

title: At the Great Sea
summary: The Lord brings Jared and his brethren to the great sea dividing the lands. They pitch tents at Moriancumer and dwell on the seashore for four years.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord brought Jared and his brethren to the great sea that divides the lands; they pitched tents and dwelt on the seashore for four years at the place they named Moriancumer.

unspecified_visual_details: The sea's appearance, number and arrangement of tents, and the travelers' appearances.

narration.text: for the space of four years

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse summarizes four years of dwelling; do not imply that all four years pass in a single instant.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Lord visibly; no appearance is stated in this verse.

title: The Lord Returns
summary: At the end of four years, the Lord comes again in a cloud, stands and talks with the brother of Jared for three hours, chastening him for not remembering to call upon the Lord.

explicit_facts.text: After four years, the Lord came again, stood in a cloud, and spoke with the brother of Jared for three hours, chastening him for forgetting to call upon the Lord.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A cloud marks the Lord's presence as the brother of Jared listens.
unspecified_visual_details: The cloud's appearance and the brother of Jared's posture and expression.

narration.text: the Lord came again unto the brother of Jared

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Lord is explicitly in a cloud; no visible bodily appearance is specified.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show a visible divine figure or invent the Lord's words.

title: Repentance and Forgiveness
summary: The brother of Jared repents and calls upon the Lord for his brethren. The Lord promises forgiveness, warns him not to sin again, and speaks of the land of inheritance.

explicit_facts.text: The brother of Jared repented and called upon the Lord for his brethren; the Lord promised forgiveness, warned against further sin, and spoke of the land of inheritance.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The brother of Jared may be shown calling upon the Lord while the Lord speaks from the cloud established in the preceding encounter.
unspecified_visual_details: The brother of Jared's posture and the cloud's appearance.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Lord's speech continues the encounter; keep it as speech rather than a separate visual event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a visible divine figure or add words beyond the quoted excerpt.

title: Build the Barges
summary: The Lord tells them to build barges in the manner of those built before. The brother of Jared and his brethren build small, light, tightly sealed barges with peaked ends and doors.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord commanded them to build barges after the manner of those built before; the brother of Jared and his brethren built small, light barges.
The barges were tightly sealed, dish-like in bottom, sides, and top, with peaked ends and a tightly fitting door; each was the length of a tree.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The brethren are building compact, sealed vessels near the sea.
unspecified_visual_details: Materials, tools, exact dimensions, and the barges' precise overall shape.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add windows, sails, or construction materials not stated in these verses.

title: The Brother of Jared Calls Out
summary: The brother of Jared cries to the Lord, reporting that he has made the barges as directed and explaining that they have no light, steering means, or air beyond what is inside.

explicit_facts.text: The brother of Jared cried to the Lord that he had completed the commanded work and that the barges had no light, steering means, or way to breathe beyond the air inside.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A completed barge may be visible nearby while he addresses the Lord.
unspecified_visual_details: The barge's exact appearance in this moment, his posture, and any visible response from the Lord.

spoken_dialogue.text: O Lord, I have performed the work
spoken_dialogue.speaker: The brother of Jared

doctrinal_or_story_notes: His concern about steering and air is reported as speech; do not portray danger as already occurring.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a spoken reply or depict occupants suffering inside the barges.

title: Instructions for Air and Water
summary: The Lord instructs the brother of Jared to make top and bottom holes, open them for air, and close them if water enters. The brother of Jared does as commanded.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord instructed him to make a hole at the top and bottom, unstop one for air, and stop it if water came in; the brother of Jared complied.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The brother of Jared may be shown making openings in a barge.
unspecified_visual_details: The openings' size and construction, and whether any water is present.

narration.text: the brother of Jared did so

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The possibility of water entering is conditional; the verse does not say it happens here.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show flooding or a rescue.

title: The Question of Light
summary: The brother of Jared asks whether the people must cross the great water in darkness. The Lord asks what he wants done for light and says windows would break and fire cannot be used for travel.

explicit_facts.text: The brother of Jared says he prepared vessels for his people but they have no light, and asks whether they must cross in darkness.
The Lord asks what should be done for light and says windows would be dashed in pieces and they would not travel by firelight.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The completed vessels may be visible as the brother of Jared addresses the Lord.
unspecified_visual_details: The vessels' placement, the cloud's appearance, and any lighting conditions.

title: Waves and the Deep
summary: The Lord describes the barges being like a whale amid mountain waves, promises to bring them up from the sea's depths, and says he prepares them against waves, winds, and floods. He asks what should be prepared for light.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord says they will be as a whale amid mountain waves, promises to bring them up from the depths, and says winds, rains, and floods are sent forth.
The Lord says he prepares them against waves, winds, and floods, and asks what he should prepare so they may have light in the depths.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The speech may be presented off-screen without depicting its metaphors as a literal event.
